speedtruth_segments.speed_limit: Posted speed limit (km/h, as supplied: TomTom, not validated)
speedtruth_segments.limit_gap_kmh: Posted limit above (+) or below (-) the survivable speed (km/h)
speedtruth_segments.robustness: Does this Priority 1 depend on the chosen weights?
speedtruth_segments.robust_pct: Share of 2,000 weightings ranking this Priority 1 (%)
speedtruth_segments.pri_equal: Priority tier if all three factors weighted equally
speedtruth_segments.pri_oper: Priority tier if measured speed weighted highest
speedtruth_segments.pri_limit: Priority tier if the posted limit weighted highest
speedtruth_segments.pri_vru: Priority tier if vulnerable road user exposure weighted highest
speedtruth_segments.c_oper: Score from: operating speed above survivable speed (points)
speedtruth_segments.c_limit: Score from: posted limit itself permits unsafe speed (points)
speedtruth_segments.c_vru: Score from: vulnerable road user exposure (points)
speedtruth_segments.score_base: Speed Safety Score before street imagery (0-100)
speedtruth_segments.imagery_used: Road condition read from street imagery?
speedtruth_segments.imagery_effect: Effect of street imagery on the survivable speed
speedtruth_segments.ped_fatal_pct: Pedestrian fatality risk if struck at observed speed (%)
speedtruth_segments.vru_per_km: Vulnerable road user generators per km
speedtruth_segments.school_market: School or market on this segment
speedtruth_segments.probe_obs: Probe vehicle observations behind the speed estimate

speedtruth_corridors.rank: Investment priority rank (within country/state, by unit type)
speedtruth_corridors.intervention: Indicative actions needed (from the most demanding segment)
speedtruth_corridors.cost_tier: Indicative cost tier of the most demanding segment (1 = lowest)
speedtruth_corridors.bcr_index: Relative benefit-cost index (unitless, not an economic appraisal)
speedtruth_corridors.possible_dual_pair: Possibly the same road counted twice (verify before funding)
